description: Retrieve a single section from a playbook by playbook ID and section ID. Used by the platform to hydrate playbook guidance into prompts during plan execution.
embedding_description: Retrieve a single section from a playbook by playbook_id + section_id. Returns the section's markdown content. Used by the platform to hydrate playbook guidance into prompts during plan execution. Section identified by `<!-- section: --> ` marker in the playbook source. Distinct from get_playbook (whole document).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieving a section from a playbook. get_playbook_section accepts {playbook_id, section_id}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: playbook or section not found. SectionNotFound: section_id does not match any <!-- section: --> marker in the playbook.
